LESSON: DANCE

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dance. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when dancing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use body movements that are part of daily experience in a variety of ways in dance for enjoyment, movements that are part of daily
2. use dance to express feelings, experiences such as greetings, waving, emotions and ideas for self- expression,
3. apply locomotor and non- locomotor/axial movements creatively in own dance for enjoyment,
4. observe basic elements of dance during performance, e) observe own and others safety during dance performance, f) practice etiquette during dance such as time, space, energy and performance for integrity, g) perform appropriate traditional dances from their locality for social cohesion and enjoyment, h) appreciate and enjoy performing traditional dances from diverse 330 Property of the Government of Kenya cultures for social cohesion and preservation of culture, i) taking pictures, recordings and videos of traditional dances for traditional dances from within their presentation and enjoyment. localities. styles using digital devices.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dance.
2. Explain Dance to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dance.
4. Show that you can: use body movements that are part of daily experience in a variety of ways in dance for enjoyment, movements that are part of daily
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dance. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when dancing?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
